channel.title: Food Safety Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Food Safety Magazine (food-safety.com)

item.title: Registration Now Open for 2026 AFDO Annual Education Conference
item.description: Taking place June 5–9 in Columbus, Ohio, the Association of Food and Drug Officials (AFDO) 130th Annual Education Conference offers sessions focused on manufactured food safety, retail food safety, and produce safety.

item.title: Study Shows Ability of Some Essential Oils to Kill Drug-Resistant Campylobacter from Poultry
item.description: Potentially offering an effective natural control strategy in food production, a study demonstrated the ability of select essential oils to inactivate multidrug-resistant Campylobacter isolated from poultry and investigated the mechanisms of antibacterial action, while highlighting variability in essential oil potency and species-specific susceptibility.

item.title: RFK Jr. Highlights FDA’s Focus on GRAS Rule, But Makes No Promises
item.description: In a recent 60 Minutes interview, U.S. Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. said FDA will address the “generally recognized as safe” (GRAS) “loophole,” which allows ingredients into the food supply without FDA review, while saying he does not plan to regulate ultra-processed foods.

item.title: SafetyChain Achieves SOC 2 Type 2 Certification
item.description: The independent audit examined how SafetyChain safeguards customer data, maintains system uptime, manages access controls, monitors risk, and responds to potential security events.

item.title: 3-A SSI Updates Hygienic Design Standards
item.description: 3-A Sanitary Standards Inc. has published new editions of its standard for farm milk cooling and holding tanks, and its foundational hygienic equipment design standard.

item.title: EU Maintains Current Stance on Safety of Sucralose After Reevaluation
item.description: EFSA conducted a safety reevaluation for the sweetener sucralose, resulting in no change to the acceptable daily intake (ADI). EFSA also considered a proposed extension for the use of sucralose in fine bakery wares, but was unable to determine its safety.

item.title: Food Safety Five Ep. 26: Updates and Success Stories on Listeria Control in RTE Facilities
item.description: This episode of Food Safety Five discusses updated USDA-FSIS guidance on Listeria testing in RTE facilities, the latest on the Boar’s Head facility behind the fatal outbreak of 2024, and a real-world Listeria “Seek and Destroy” success story.

item.title: Strategic Advantages of Natural, Non-GMO Decorative Ingredients
item.description: Manufacturers that proactively align decorative ingredients with clean-label, non-GMO, and allergen management strategies are better positioned to meet retailer requirements, reduce operational risk, and respond to changing consumer values.

item.title: Study Shows How Swab Storage Time, Temperature Affect Allergen Detection
item.description: The findings reinforce the importance of current best practice, which recommends same-day delivery on ice.

item.title: RFK Jr. Elevates Top FDA Human Foods Official to HHS Management Team
item.description: U.S. Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has announced several appointments to his immediate management team at HHS, including FDA Deputy Commissioner for Human Foods Kyle Diamantas, reportedly to help advance food-related MAHA agenda items.
